four_questions.question: what_was_claimed
four_questions.answer: The retained source contracts describe governed event ingress, state-transition custody, evidence retention and predecessor-linked reconstruction; this source declaration is not runtime proof.

four_questions.question: what_was_independently_observed
four_questions.answer: No authenticated current Exp3 organization-ledger event and matching Master Records response has been read back in this SDK manifest.
unknowns: Whether a qualifying resident transition exists outside accessible evidence

four_questions.question: what_physical_work_occurred
four_questions.answer: No independently sampled physical outcome or activity-side measurement is bound to an Exp3 receipt.
unknowns: Physical activity outside SDK or Node instrumentation

four_questions.question: what_remains_unknown
four_questions.answer: Unknowns and disagreements are retained per observer rather than merged into presumed truth; undeclared shared blind spots are not exhaustively enumerable.

dimensions.capability: Canonical registered-Node event, current Interlock/InTr transition and bounded execution can emit distinct, attributable receipts when actually exercised.
dimensions.limit: Source declarations and downstream receipts cannot observe an uninstrumented partner environment; an activity-side omission may never enter the ledger.
dimensions.verification: Match a sampled external activity source against exact registered-Node ingress, execution and organization-ledger receipts; report missing coverage separately from inaccessible evidence.

dimensions.capability: Existing canonical source specifies exact state-transition and required-evidence digests with independently recomputable Master Records reconstruction.
dimensions.limit: Source or CI conformance, self-issued hashes and documented API contracts do not establish real execution, physical truth, record completeness or independence of custody.
dimensions.verification: Fetch exact registered transition and its organization receipt and corresponding Master Records RECORDED/PASS/PASS response; recompute hashes and deliberately mutate evidence.

dimensions.capability: Canonical source defines retention of exact state-transition receipts and each bound required-evidence item through authoritative organization-first and Master Records custody.
dimensions.limit: Retention code alone does not prove current resident durability, complete external-event coverage, third-party separation, recovery after loss or an immutable physical-world observation.
dimensions.verification: From authenticated resident organization HEAD enumerate all linked immutable receipts, query Master Records by exact transition and compare every retained evidence item and retention/loss policy.

dimensions.capability: The canonical contract requires exact predecessor-linked state receipt and required evidence reconstruction before machine-owned successor progression.
dimensions.limit: Reconstruction can recover only actually retained states; it cannot infer unreported actions, undisclosed blind spots, physical causation or reconcile disagreement as though consensus were observed.
dimensions.verification: Independently replay a complete sampled receipt window including interleaved organization transitions; require each immediate predecessor and exact digest equality; retain participant dissent and independent unknowns.
